fileManifest.reason: Caller-scoped fix review: _route_post_preview lines 618-653, focused on the stale-state re-read added at 644-650

summary.description: The fix re-reads state.json right after sync_pr runs and swaps it into `st` only when the read succeeds and returns a dict, so a dedupe write from sync_pr (draft -> posted, e.g. a timed-out client post the fake/real gh still recorded) is visible to _post_items instead of a stale pre-sync snapshot. Verified against cw_store.read_json (returns None on OSError/ValueError, matching the isinstance guard), notes.sync_comments/_dedupe_drafts (confirms sync_pr can flip draft->posted and that do_sync round-trips the full state object, so meta and other keys survive), and cw_run.sync_pr (confirmed it never raises, so the guard's fallback-on-None path also covers a sync_pr failure cleanly, since an unchanged file re-reads identically). The existing test test_cw_post.py::test_retry_after_timeout_does_not_double_post exercises exactly this path end to end (preview, timeout, second preview, second post, then a direct notes.py deliver) and the implementer confirmed it was not modified by this fix. No blocker, major, or minor issues found in the reviewed lines.

evaluation.message: Root cause correctly identified and fixed with a minimal, defensively-guarded re-read; existing test already covers the scenario end to end. No changes requested.
